heroDescription: Digital platform developed by UTFPR students for storage, visualization and search of molecular compound chemical structures, promoting interdisciplinarity between computing, chemistry and biotechnology.
featuresSubtitle: Advanced tools for chemical structure research and analysis
storageDesc: Robust database to store and organize molecular chemical structures
searchDesc: Intelligent search system to find specific compounds by chemical properties
visualizationDesc: Intuitive interface to visualize molecular structures in 2D and 3D
aboutDescription: The LMW DataBase project was developed by students at the Federal University of Technology - Paraná (UTFPR) to create a digital platform for storage, visualization and search of molecular compound chemical structures. The initiative addresses the growing demand for digital tools that integrate interactive resources into chemistry research and teaching, promoting interdisciplinarity across computing, chemistry and biotechnology.
